TEXT.English: The Danwei Committee replaces the Courthouse for the People's Republic of China. It represents the work-unit governance structure that tied administration, labor coordination, and neighborhood-level political supervision together inside factories and urban districts.

Build Danwei Committees in your high-maintenance cities to stabilize costs while adding production and espionage pressure. They are especially strong in industrial cores where a Spy specialist slot and extra espionage help counter-tech rivals.

The People's Volunteer replaces Infantry for the People's Republic of China. It models politically hardened field forces optimized for sustained campaigning in difficult terrain and costly attritional warfare.
Use People's Volunteers as your front-line industrial infantry. Their hill defense, city attack, and modest withdrawal chance make them reliable in grinding offensives and rough-border wars.
